tasks.name: Threads publisher
tasks.description: Posts approved, due rows from the Google Sheet queue to Threads.

tasks.name: Threads token refresh
tasks.description: Refreshes the 60 day Threads access token and saves it to .env.

tasks.name: Threads researcher
tasks.description: Searches your keywords on Threads, stores posts and engagement snapshots, ranks them, and writes the top 25 to the research tab.

tasks.name: Threads insights pull
tasks.description: Reads views, likes, replies, reposts and your follower count, and refreshes the insights and followers tabs.

tasks.name: Weekly look-back
tasks.description: Monday 09:00. Week in numbers, what worked, what did not, a verdict on every experiment we ran, 3 tests for next week and a goal-path check. Writes the weekly tab and reviews/weekly_DATE.md.

tasks.name: Content top-up + daily brief
tasks.description: Checks every 3 hours and writes a new batch of 48 only when the queue runs less than 20 hours ahead, so posting never gaps. Every post is auto-approved. Each batch also writes the daily_brief tab: learnings from the last batch and what we are testing next.

tasks.name: Content drafts from research
tasks.description: Planned: Claude analyses the top research posts and adds original draft rows to the queue (approved left blank).

tasks.name: Replace unapproved posts
tasks.description: Every 10 minutes. If you untick approved on a queued engine post, a fresh replacement is written into the same slot and auto-approved. Unticked posts never publish. Your rejections also teach the engine what to avoid.

tasks.name: X publisher
tasks.description: Posts due rows from the x_queue tab to X, one per run, and swaps a reserve into any unticked post.

tasks.name: X daily cycle
tasks.description: Researches X, reviews yesterday's X posts, learns, then writes today's 12 X posts (X only brand).

tasks.name: X post review
tasks.description: Reads X metrics as posts cross 1h, 6h, 24h, 72h and 7d (only then, so reads stay low), verdicts at 24h, x_review tab.

tasks.name: X weekly look-back
tasks.description: Monday summary of the X week: what worked, test verdicts, whether Threads winners carry over.

tasks.name: Brain sync
tasks.description: Pulls Threads and X posts, metrics at fixed ages, follower counts, research and your notes into one ledger; labels posts, attributes follows, scores everything, refreshes brain_scores.
